newsitem.title: USA: Aunt charged with selling toddler nieces for sex.
newsitem.headline: Aunt charged with selling toddler nieces for sex.

text.p: An Atlanta woman sold her two toddler nieces for sex for $15 in an apparent attempt to raise money to buy crack cocaine, police said on Wednesday.
The 30-year-old woman, identified only as the children's aunt, told their mother on Monday that she was taking the girls to a local park and to get candy.
But she and the children, aged 2 and 3, instead showed up at the apartment of 28-year-old Ronald Murphy in a squalid southeast Atlanta neighbourhood known as Peoplestown.
Police, who claim the woman had provided the children to Murphy for sex numerous times in recent weeks, were later called to the man's neighbourhood to break up an angry crowd.
They found the girls' mother, grandmother and several of Murphy's neighbours beating both him and the aunt with sticks.
"I'm very angry -- angry enough to kill, really," a woman identified as the children's grandmother told NBC-affiliate WXIA-TV.
Murphy was arrested and charged with aggravated sexual battery, aggravated sodomy and child molestation.
The aunt remained in jail Wednesday with bail set at $20,000. She was charged with reckless conduct and solicitation for sodomy.
